question: What understanding has been attained through the grace of the lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge has arisen by that lord's grace.
The object known is the determination of Kaula.
inference: Through the lord of the Kaulas' grace, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
